one_line: Product held to the lens in the first second, then one calm, sped-up top-down drawing to a finished card.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on white paper: a pencil outline of a honey dipper dripping into a jar, a Giotto Olio Maxi box cut by the top edge. 0:01 a hand holds the box up, label legible. No speech, no text.
q1_hook.why: The product is shown and handled within the first second, with a cut at 0.7 s (S1, E1), and the outline raises the question of what it will become (H5). But there is no spoken or written line, so the hook is picture only (H6).

beats.what: Pencil outline of a honey dipper and jar; the box held up to the lens
beats.why: Product and an empty drawing to fill

beats.what: A hand opens the 12-pastel box and colours the jar yellow
Orange shading and red outline on the jar's cover; pastels leave the tray as they are used
beats.why: Visible progress, a change every second

beats.what: Honey drips and the dipper filled in yellow and orange
White pastel highlights on the jar
A red handwritten greeting, "שנה מתוקה" and a second word, completes the card
beats.why: Names the occasion on the last frame

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "איך יצא? ❤️". Nothing in the video asks for a comment, save or send.
q2_flow.why: The outline is a question the drawing answers, with the finished card and its greeting as the last frame (H5, R4). The picture changes every second inside one take, with no dead air (R3, R1). 18 s suits one visual moment (R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: "איך יצא? ❤️" and the tag "בשיתוף @giotto_israel". No link, code, save or send ask.
q3_cta.why: The sell is light and there is a single question (C7, C1). But it asks how the creator's card came out, not the viewer's, so it is not an open question from their own life (C5). A holiday card worth saving gets no save or send prompt (R7).

q4_shown.what: A Giotto Olio Maxi box held up and opened 0:00 to 0:02, label legible; an adult hand colouring step by step, the box staying at the top of the frame; the finished honey-jar card with a red greeting. No face, no child, no price.
q4_shown.why: The box is handled in the first second (S1). It stays in frame all through, a steady brand pulse inside the action, never a logo card (H3, K5). Hands only carry the whole Reel (S4). The finished card is the proof.

q5_edit.what: 5 shots in 17.7 s: cuts at 0.7, 2.4, 4.2 and 6.1 s, then one 11.5 s fixed top-down take. The drawing is sped up (a jar fills in about 4 s). No text, no speech. It ends on the finished card.
q5_edit.why: A cut by 0.7 s opens with motion (E1). The speed-up is on hands and an object, as advised (E3). It ends on the payoff with almost no tail (E8). With no voice or text, the edit carries no message for a muted viewer (E4).

q6_topic.what: A Rosh Hashanah greeting card, a honey jar drawn in oil pastels; serves anyone wanting an easy holiday card.
q6_topic.why: A holiday and a card to send fit a real buying and giving moment (K7), though only the greeting on the last frame and the caption name it. The mood is calm and satisfying, not high arousal (K1). A card is something to make and send to someone (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone fixed above a white sheet on a table, locked for the 11.5 s take; even light; the pastel box at the top of the frame, cut by the edge in the first shot; a close-up of the box label at 0:01; one adult hand.
q7_filmed.why: A fixed top-down view with a hand is the first-choice format (F5, S4). The box label and the drawing fill the frame (F4). Sharp, evenly lit, homemade (F7). The box is cut by the top edge in the first shot (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: No overlay text, no subtitles, no CTA. The only words are printed on the box ("GIOTTO OLIO MAXI", "12 maxi oil pastels") and the red handwritten greeting "שנה מתוקה" at 0:16, plus a second word I could not read.
q8_text.caption: "צנצנת דבש 🍯". About 34 words: the product line "השתמשתי בצבעי הפסטל שמן המעולים של ג'יאוטו", the card idea, "איך יצא? ❤️", 5 hashtags (#giotto #honeyjar #roshhashana #ראשהשנה #כרטיסברכה), last line "בשיתוף @giotto_israel".
q8_text.why: With no headline and no voice, the Reel states neither the task nor the occasion in the video (T1, T3). The caption's first line is a plain keyword, with product, occasion and exactly 5 hashtags, three of them in English (T7). The partner line is last, with no paid label (T8).

weak_points: No headline or voice naming the occasion; no save, send or make-it prompt; a vague caption question; the first frame is only an outline; the partner line is last.
lumebook_takeaway: Fix the phone above a table: show the product in the first second, then a sped-up hands-only step-by-step, ending on the finished page.
not_verified: Music (transcript only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). The second word of the handwritten greeting. Correction to coded file: the index counts 5 shots, not 4.
